details: The brush and zoom handlers fire full canvas redraws (LTTB + canvas paint) and an O(N) stats loop on every mousemove with no RAF coalescing or debouncing — a clear update storm. The infinite-loop risk is well-handled via a `syncing` flag, stale-closure risk is avoided by using `transform.rescaleX(xFull)`, no D3 transitions are used so there is no mid-flight handoff issue, and the zoom filter guards against right-click without explicit touch/mouse conflicts.
